strings.name: Rodney Brooks
strings.role: Roboticist and Robust.AI co-founder and CTO
strings.country: Australian-born; works in the United States
strings.summary: Brooks argues for understanding robot intelligence through perception, action and interaction with the world. He advanced behavior-based robotics, taught at MIT and directed its AI laboratory, and co-founded iRobot, Rethink Robotics and Robust.AI, pursuing home and industrial applications while also experiencing startup failure.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 16 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: He advanced behavior-based robotics and co-founded iRobot, helping move robots from laboratories into consumer and industrial applications.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birthplace
strings.facts.f2.label: Education
strings.facts.f2.value: Pure-mathematics degrees from Flinders University; computer science Ph.D., Stanford, 1981.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Building intelligence from behavior
strings.highlights.h1.text: Layered control and real-world interaction challenged approaches requiring a complete world model before action, influencing embodied and autonomous robotics.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Putting robots to work
strings.highlights.h2.text: With teams he pursued cleaning, manufacturing and logistics applications; engineering, markets and operations shaped both the achievements and limits of products such as Roomba and Baxter.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Updating his technology predictions scorecard
strings.timeline.t1.text: He reviewed forecasts about autonomous driving, robots, AI and spaceflight, distinguishing earlier judgments, observed progress and new personal predictions.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Co-founding Robust.AI
strings.timeline.t2.text: He and collaborators formed a new robotics company to pursue systems capable of operating in real workplaces.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Original Rethink Robotics operations end
strings.timeline.t3.text: The company founded in 2008 ceased operating; its collaborative-robot ideas were influential without guaranteeing business survival.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Introducing Baxter
strings.timeline.t4.text: Rethink’s team launched a two-armed collaborative robot designed for work near people and easier task teaching in manufacturing.
strings.timeline.t5.title: iRobot introduces Roomba
strings.timeline.t5.text: The company he co-founded launched a home vacuum robot, bringing mobile robotics into a consumer market.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Co-founding iRobot
strings.timeline.t6.text: With Colin Angle and Helen Greiner, he formed a company to explore practical mobile robots.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Publishing layered-control research
strings.timeline.t7.text: His IEEE paper described robust layered control for a mobile robot, becoming an important work on subsumption architecture and behavior-based methods.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Joining MIT’s faculty
strings.timeline.t8.text: After research and teaching elsewhere, he joined MIT, later leading robotics research and becoming AI laboratory director in 1997.
strings.timeline.t9.title: Earning his Stanford doctorate
strings.timeline.t9.text: He completed a computer science Ph.D., with computer vision as an early academic focus.
